unstuck_said.text: Researched live agent at traderszone.net with agent.json (A2A MCP), free/search_agents skill, and x402 paid skills. All settlement is USDC on Base — no XNO. This is a prime candidate for a "could you add an accepts-XNO attribute to agent cards" feature request to the A2A protocol it uses. Filed as upstream potential for Rai.
